modules.title: Module 1: Pre-Market Catalysts & Institutional News Feed
modules.purpose: Stores hard-coded high-impact institutional headlines (FII flows, RBI repo rates, OPEC crude disruptions) used to prime AI models before market opens.
modules.layman: Think of this as the morning newspaper headlines that the AI reads before deciding whether the market will go up or down today.
modules.ui_extract: News & Catalyst Sentiment Feed in bottom panel of terminal

modules.title: Module 2: Server Bootstrapping, FastAPI & Security Middleware
modules.purpose: Initializes the FastAPI application, configures Windows high-speed asyncio loops, sets up CORS headers and secure cookie session middleware.
modules.layman: The foundation and security guards of the app. It turns on the server, locks the doors so only logged-in users enter, and allows the browser to talk to Python.
modules.ui_extract: User Login status and Connection Dot in top navigation bar

modules.title: Module 3: Resilient Dual-Feed Engine (Upstox + YFinance)
modules.purpose: Provides real-time market prices with automatic failover: queries Upstox API first; if market is closed or API limits trigger, smoothly falls back to Yahoo Finance.
modules.layman: Like having a backup generator. If the primary power (Upstox) cuts off, the secondary power (Yahoo Finance) kicks in instantly so your screen never goes blank.
modules.ui_extract: Live LTP numbers on top ticker and watchlist

modules.title: Module 4: SQLite Database Engine & Data Tables
modules.purpose: Creates SQLite tables (users, recommendations, orders, positions, watchlists, logs) and provides thread-safe db_exec() query executions.
modules.layman: The digital filing cabinet where every trade you make, every recommendation generated, and your account balance are permanently saved.
modules.ui_extract: Past trades table and wallet balance in header

modules.title: Module 5: Upstox Token Manager, OAuth & Webhooks
modules.purpose: Handles broker OAuth login flow, persists daily access tokens, downloads NSE/BSE contract master files, and handles incoming WebSocket ticks.
modules.layman: The handshake between you and your real stock broker. It keeps you securely logged into your trading account without having to re-enter your password every 5 minutes.
modules.ui_extract: Broker Connected badge in top right corner

modules.title: Module 6: Quantitative Black-Scholes Pricing & Greeks Engine
modules.purpose: Calculates Black-Scholes option theoretical value (bs_price) and Greek sensitivities (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, Rho, Implied Volatility).
modules.layman: The mathematical brain for options. It calculates how much an option price will move if the stock goes up 10 rupees (Delta), or how much value it loses each night while you sleep (Theta).
modules.ui_extract: Option Greeks cards (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, IV) in the Option Chain tab

modules.title: Module 7: Core Technical Analysis & Indicator Formulas
modules.purpose: Takes raw candle series and calculates RSI (momentum), ATR (volatility range), EMA 20/50/200 (trend direction), Supertrend, and support/resistance levels.
modules.layman: The speedometer, compass, and fuel gauge of the market. It tells you whether price is speeding up (RSI), how choppy the road is (ATR), and which way the hill slopes (EMA).
modules.ui_extract: Technical Confluence Meter (RSI 54.2, ATR 12.5) on chart

modules.title: Module 8: Autonomous Recommendation Engine (overall_recommendation)
modules.purpose: Combines multi-timeframe candle trends, option chain open interest, and news sentiment to output BUY CALL / BUY PUT signals, with precise Entry, Target, and Stop-Loss.
modules.layman: The AI trading coach. It looks at all charts and news simultaneously and says: 'Buy NIFTY 24500 CE at 120, take profit at 145, get out if it drops to 105'.
modules.ui_extract: CA AI Recommendation Card (BUY CALL, Entry, Target, SL, Conviction)

modules.title: Module 9: Historical Replay, Backtesting & Calibration Engine
modules.purpose: Simulates historical sessions without future lookahead (simulate_5m_trade_series), evaluating whether trades hit target or stop-loss on point-in-time candles.
modules.layman: A time machine for traders. It lets you test trading strategies on random past dates (like September 2026) to see if you would have made or lost money.
modules.ui_extract: 100-Trade Backtest Report and Replay Canvas

modules.title: Module 10: Option Chain Matrix & Strike Scanner
modules.purpose: Builds tabular matrix of calls and puts across all strike prices with open interest, volume, Greeks, and ATM/ITM/OTM highlight classification.
modules.layman: The menu card of the options market. Shows every strike price available to buy or sell, with prices and buyer/seller activity.
modules.ui_extract: Option Chain table tab with CE / PE columns

modules.title: Module 11: Paper Trading Simulator & P&L Calculator
modules.purpose: Accepts virtual and live orders, tracks live open positions, executes trailing stop-losses, and updates user net P&L and wallet margin.
modules.layman: Your practice trading account. You can place trades with virtual money to test your ideas without risking a single rupee of real capital.
modules.ui_extract: Open Positions tab, P&L badge, and Net Gain/Loss counter

modules.title: Module 12: Telegram Alerts, News Feed & MCP AI Endpoints
modules.purpose: Dispatches high-priority signals to Telegram channels, serves news feeds, and exposes Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoints for ChatGPT and external AI agents.
modules.layman: The loudspeaker and external AI bridge. Sends instant alerts to your phone via Telegram and lets ChatGPT ask our server for trading data.
modules.ui_extract: Telegram Notification toggle in settings & /api/mcp/manifest

modules.title: Section 1: HTML Head, Meta Tags & Resiliency Shield
modules.purpose: Initializes HTML5 document, sets up CDN preconnects, defines PWA manifest, and injects a fallback markdown parser shield to prevent script crashes.
modules.layman: The loading dock. Sets up connections to external resources so fonts and scripts load fast, and puts safety nets in place so the page never freezes.
modules.ui_extract: Browser tab title and page head loading

modules.title: Section 2: CSS Stylesheet & Theme Design System
modules.purpose: Defines CSS custom properties (:root), dark mode color palette, glowing badge styles, glassmorphism cards, and hardware-accelerated animations.
modules.layman: The paint, furniture, and lighting of the app. Dictates how dark the background is, how buttons glow neon green or red, and makes everything look sleek.
modules.ui_extract: Dark theme styling, card borders, neon buttons, fonts

modules.title: Section 3: Top Navigation Bar & Account Status
modules.purpose: HTML markup for the main app header: CA Trader branding, Live/Sim mode toggle, market status clock, wallet balance, and user profile avatar.
modules.layman: The dashboard header. Shows whether the market is currently open, your available cash balance, and switches between Live and Practice mode.
modules.ui_extract: Top horizontal navigation bar on the screen

modules.title: Section 4: Live Rolling Ticker Rail (Marquee)
modules.purpose: Continuous horizontal ticker marquee showing real-time prices and percentage changes for NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX, CRUDEOIL, and RELIANCE.
modules.layman: The stock ticker tape running across the screen, just like on CNBC or Bloomberg TV, showing price movements in real time.
modules.ui_extract: Top rolling ticker tape right under the header

modules.title: Section 5: Watchlist Sidebar & Search Input
modules.purpose: Left sidebar layout containing category tabs (Indices, Equity, F&O, Commodities), instant search filter, and list of tracked instruments.
modules.layman: Your personal stock catalog. Lets you pick which index or stock you want to focus on (e.g., clicking BANKNIFTY switches the whole screen).
modules.ui_extract: Left vertical column with stock items

modules.title: Section 6: Interactive Charting Canvas & Timeframes
modules.purpose: Center stage container with timeframe selector (1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 1D), technical indicator toggles (EMA, RSI, ATR), and interactive candlestick drawing canvas.
modules.layman: The main candlestick chart where you see price candles forming, green for up and red for down, with moving averages floating on top.
modules.ui_extract: Big central chart area

modules.title: Section 7: Historical Backtest & Replay UI (btRecoCard)
modules.purpose: Dedicated replay interface showing point-in-time recommendation verdict, entry price, stop-loss, target, and indicator confluence per candle.
modules.layman: The simulation cockpit. Displays what the AI thought on that exact candle in history, showing entry price, stop loss, and target.
modules.ui_extract: Replay Recommendation card (BUY CALL, Entry, SL, Target)

modules.title: Section 8: Recommendation Signal & Order Execution Pad
modules.purpose: Right-hand panel displaying current live AI signal, rationale breakdown, and one-click 'BUY CALL' or 'BUY PUT' execution buttons.
modules.layman: The action pad. Where the AI shows its top trade recommendation of the moment, and with one click of the BUY button you enter the trade.
modules.ui_extract: Right column with BUY CALL / BUY PUT buttons

modules.title: Section 9: Interactive Option Chain Matrix
modules.purpose: Full-width table comparing Call options on left and Put options on right, with strike prices in center, highlighting ATM strike and Greeks.
modules.layman: The complete spreadsheet of options for the current week or month, color-coded so you instantly see which options are profitable.
modules.ui_extract: Option Chain tab table

modules.title: Section 10: Greek Learning & Simulation Modal
modules.purpose: Interactive popup modal triggered when clicking any Greek stat card ('Learn') allowing users to simulate price changes against Delta and Theta.
modules.layman: An interactive popup calculator where you slide stock price up or down to see exactly how much money your option will make.
modules.ui_extract: The Greek Simulation popup modal

modules.title: Section 11: JavaScript Global State & Polling Engine
modules.purpose: Initializes state object, manages API fetch cycles every 2-3 seconds, handles error recovery, and synchronizes tabs.
modules.layman: The heartbeat of the frontend. Every 2 seconds it calls the backend server to get the latest prices and keeps the screen fresh without reloading the page.
modules.ui_extract: Continuous automatic screen refresh without full page reload

modules.title: Section 12: DOM Renderers & Signal Decoders
modules.purpose: Functions like selectDashboardRecoOption(), renderWatchlist(), updateTicker() that convert backend JSON data into HTML elements.
modules.layman: The construction crew. When the backend sends fresh data, these functions build the HTML tags and inject the numbers into the right boxes.
modules.ui_extract: Dynamic updates to badges, numbers, and tables

modules.title: Section 13: Keyboard Shortcuts, Audio Alerts & Theme Toggles
modules.purpose: Event listeners for keyboard navigation (B for Buy, S for Sell), audio chimes when a target is hit, toast notifications, and dark/light mode toggle.
modules.layman: The sound effects and shortcuts. Plays a celebratory bell sound when your trade hits target, and allows power traders to trade using keyboard keys.
modules.ui_extract: Target hit chime, toast popups in bottom right

interactive_presets.title: Lesson 1: The 'BUY CALL / BUY PUT' Action Buttons
interactive_presets.description: How the terminal decides whether to show a green 'BUY CALL' badge or red 'BUY PUT' badge, and how you can style it or change the text.
interactive_presets.layman: In trading, if you think the market is going UP, you buy a CALL (green). If you think it's going DOWN, you buy a PUT (red). Here is the exact code that controls that button.
interactive_presets.code_snippet: BUY CALL /* Styling from CSS */ .verdict-badge.buy { background: rgba(38, 217, 166, 0.15); color: #26d9a6; border: 1px solid rgba(38, 217, 166, 0.4); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

interactive_presets.title: Lesson 2: Recommendation Entry, Target & Stop-Loss Cards
interactive_presets.description: How the backend calculates Target and Stop-Loss using ATR (Average True Range), and how the frontend displays them in glowing cards.
interactive_presets.layman: A trade without a target and stop-loss is like driving without brakes. If Entry is 100, Target might be 125 (profit), and Stop-Loss 85 (maximum safety limit).
interactive_presets.code_snippet:
# app.py (Lines 11998-12000)
target_gain = round(max(atr * target_mult, entry * 0.0004), 2)
sl_dist = round(max(atr * sl_mult, entry * 0.0015), 2)
target = round(entry + target_gain, 2)
stop_loss = round(entry - sl_dist, 2)

interactive_presets.title: Lesson 3: Option Greeks Stat Cards (Delta & Theta)
interactive_presets.description: How Black-Scholes computes Delta (how much option moves per 1 rupee index move) and displays it in interactive cards with the Learn button.
interactive_presets.layman: Delta is your speed multiplier: Delta 0.50 means if NIFTY moves 100, your option moves 50. Theta is time decay: how much rent your option pays every day.

interactive_presets.title: Lesson 4: Watchlist Active Item Card
interactive_presets.description: How each stock/index is displayed in the sidebar with live price, net points change, and green/red percentage pill.
interactive_presets.layman: Your watchlist item is a live identity badge for each stock. When price goes up, it flashes green; when price drops, it flashes red.
interactive_presets.code_snippet:
BANKNIFTY NSE INDEX
INR 53,420.50 +1.24%

interactive_presets.title: Lesson 5: Rolling Ticker Marquee
interactive_presets.description: The continuously sliding marquee tape at the top of the screen that tracks all major benchmark indices.
interactive_presets.layman: Like a sports ticker showing scores across different games, this ticker loops smoothly across your screen using CSS animations.

interactive_presets.title: Lesson 6: Technical Confluence Meter (RSI & EMA)
interactive_presets.description: How the system decides if an asset is oversold (RSI < 30), bullish (RSI > 50), or overbought (RSI > 70) and paints the confluence meter.
interactive_presets.layman: Think of RSI as a thermometer: Below 30 is freezing (oversold, ready to bounce). Above 70 is boiling (overbought, ready to cool down). Around 50 is comfortably warm.
interactive_presets.code_snippet:
# app.py (Lines 11811-11816)
if trend == 'BUY' or (rsi >= 48):
    signal = 'BUY'
    confidence = round(min(94.0, 65.0 + max(0, rsi - 48) * 1.2), 1)
else:
    signal = 'SELL'
    confidence = round(min(92.0, 62.0 + max(0, 52 - rsi) * 1.2), 1)
